note: The highest campground in Custer State Park, a short walk south of Sylvan Lake on the Needles Highway; sites are close together under pines among granite outcrops, and most tent sites are walk-in. The Needles Highway east of the lake has low, narrow tunnels (Needles Eye 8 ft 0 in wide by 9 ft 9 in high), so come up SD-89 north from Custer instead. --Claude
summary: GFP csp-campgrounds + scenic drives + Go Outdoors SD facID 13 (loop 26) read: 39 sites - 24 electric 20/30/50 A (21 reservable, 20-27 ft, $34; SL32E pull-thru), 14 tent-only $16 mostly walk-in, 1 host; RVs over 27 ft not suitable; open Open House Weekend-Oct 1. Hookups electric 50 and facilities added. Fees low 16 = tent tier, platform 'phone' and phone 800-number flagged (manual).
flags: FEES (manual, not overwritten): stored nightly_low 16 / nightly_high 27. GFP: '$16/night per unit tent only with no electricity, $34/night per unit campsite with electric hookup' - $16 is the tent tier (12-16 ft, mostly hike-in), the $27 tier does not exist at Sylvan Lake; base a 23-ft rig can book is $34. Recommend nightly_low 34, nightly_high 34.

BOOKING (manual, not overwritten): stored platform 'phone' - GFP says 'Make reservation online or call 1.800.710.2267' and the Go Outdoors SD engine sells these sites online (facID 13, loop 26, ReservableOnline true). Recommend platform 'operator' (the state:SD row's value) and url https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=13 (website's facID 13 checked = Custer SP).
PHONE: 1.800.710.2267 (the park-wide reservation line) -> 605.394.2693 (Custer State Park's number on GFP's park page).

TUNNELS / ROUTE: Needles Highway (SD-87N) east of Sylvan Lake: Needles Eye Tunnel 8'0" wide by 9'9" high, Iron Creek Tunnel 8'9" wide by 10'10" high (GFP scenic drives). A rig ~8 ft 1 in wide with mirrors and up to 10.5 ft tall should not take the Needles Eye tunnel. Non-tunnel route (GFP): SD-89 north from US-16A in Custer to Sylvan Lake.

FIT: 'not suitable for ... RVs over 27 feet'; 21 reservable electric sites at 25-27 ft (SL24E 20 ft) - a 23-ft rig fits. The old note's '30 sites, 25 with electric' was wrong (39 sites, 24 electric of which 3 are non-reservable 10-ft units).
WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront confirmed (Sylvan Lake ~1/4 mile north, across the highway, under pines). PIN 43.84059,-103.55752 is ~110 m from the site centroid (~43.8397,-103.5568) - fine.
SEASON/SITES (manual): 'Open House Weekend - Oct. 1', count 39 and max_rig_ft 27 confirmed; SL32E is a pull-thru (sites.pull_through not written - manual group).
